sections.content: HTML-level security starts with escaping: never inject unescaped user content into the DOM (XSS), sanitize anything rendered, and set security headers via your server.
iframes from untrusted sources should use sandbox attributes; forms need CSRF tokens; and links should use rel="noopener" for target="_blank".
Key points: escape & < > " in user text, Content-Security-Policy headers restrict what can load/run, and HTTPS is mandatory for any real site.
Try this variation — change a value, predict the output, then run it:

<iframe src="https://maps.example.com" sandbox="allow-scripts" referrerpolicy="no-referrer"></iframe>
